title: Surfaces with a label
deciding_test: Two questions. (1) Is my content ONE BLOCK or an ARRAY OF UNIFORM ROWS? (2) If an array — does each row have a HIDDEN part, and is the row PRESSABLE? The label is drawn by the frame via the label prop; the caller never builds it with Typography.

title: Rows and lists without a card surface
deciding_test: Same shape as the SurfaceCard family, differing on exactly one axis: whether there is a bg-surface or not.

title: Hide and show on click
deciding_test: Two independent questions, asked in order. (1) Count the collapsible regions. (2) Is there an outer background, border, radius, or padding?

title: Text
deciding_test: Three steps by STRING SHAPE, not by length. The hard boundary between step 2 and 3 is block-level: MarkdownContent emits block markup and drives its own vertical rhythm, so it cannot legally nest inside a button, trigger, or inline label; RichText emits inline markup, so it can nest anywhere.

title: Payload authored by a writer or decided by data
deciding_test: The shape is decided by the payload; the component does not know it in advance.

title: Classification labels, chips, tokens
deciding_test: Four doors, chosen by DATA SHAPE.

title: Measurements
deciding_test: A bar takes exactly one question: how many TOTALS? A stat tile takes: who supplies the surface, and what does the cell hold?

title: Label-value pairs and tables
deciding_test: Enter by whether the pairs are a fixed set of fields or rows of the same record.

title: Frames and rhythm
deciding_test: The axis is something I choose, not something the component guesses.

title: Page, region, overlay
deciding_test: Enter by what the thing covers: a whole route, a region inside one, or the screen itself.

title: Async, notifications, empty holes
deciding_test: Two questions. (1) The shape of the PLACEMENT — a strip inside a surface, or a centered hole? (2) HEIGHT — is this an async region or not?

title: Inputs and forms
deciding_test: Form atoms CARRY THEIR OWN label, hint, errorMessage, isRequired (teacher confirmed 2026-07-25; the old Field.* layer is DELETED). There is no component for wrapping a label around a field.

title: Buttons and actions
deciding_test: Enter by how many actions there are and where the row sits.

title: Navigation
deciding_test: Four rungs of the same tab problem: pure-data items, then the caller builds the tree when each tab needs its own chrome, then a row with TWO tab groups on either side, then that row sitting inside a card surface.

title: Identity, images, small signifiers
deciding_test: Enter by what the image stands for: a person, an entity cover, the brand, or a free image.
